prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / productivity-visual.
Input image1 is the edit target and exact style reference. Redesign only slide23 body to correct the distinction between deliverable existence and tool output provenance.
Preserve exact title「測試跑完，怎麼確認達標？」and blue underline. Preserve cream faint graph paper,16:9 wide canvas, navy natural handwritten PEN lettering, delicate ink outlines, blue/teal hatched fills. Match current deck typography, no brush calligraphy, no printed fonts. Highest native clarity. All text large and readable minimum visually30pt, generous white space.
Two balanced columns:
LEFT heading verbatim「交付成果」. Simple formal report document icon, no magnifying glass implying source detection. Large question underneath verbatim「指定報告有交付嗎？」. This column checks only the required deliverable exists, NOT who produced it.
RIGHT heading verbatim「工具呼叫紀錄」. Clear minimal record card with wrench/document icon and two successive entries linked vertically, labeled「呼叫 Builder」then「Tool 回傳結果」. Under this card, a small separate document labeled「最後交付」. Link「Tool 回傳結果」to「最後交付」with a clean visual comparison connector labeled「對照」, not an automatic handoff or a pass mark. This shows that source verification needs the recorded tool result to be compared to final delivery.
Under the right column, two large questions on separate lines, verbatim:
「Builder 有呼叫嗎？」
「交付的是它的結果嗎？」
No bottom takeaway sentence, leave airy bottom margin. No statement that inspecting the report reveals Builder provenance. No implication that a recorded tool call alone proves its output was delivered. No selected checks, success percentages, score, page numbers, watermark, or extra labels. Icons use same simple semantic pen outlines as input. Avoid crowding: right record/compare illustration compact but labels remain readable; body questions fully within canvas.
visualReview: Left checks delivery only. Right uses recorded Builder call and Tool result compared to final delivery. Text accurate, no fabricated success or source inference from report appearance.
